observations: body: the rules of the frame are printed heavy outside and thin inside, the rules between the groups of the years heavy (about 1.9 pt); set as in the other tables.
body: the hyphens of «al-muḥarram», «’l-qa‘dah», «’l-ḥiǵǵah» and of the Persian months («-māh») are printed longer, like en dashes; transcribed -.
body L5, L7: a speck like a colon and a dot are printed below «ṣafar»; not transcribed.
body L5: a dot is printed below the hyphen of «ardibihisht-māh»; not transcribed.
body L1: a dot is printed to the right of «f. 241,r.», above it; not transcribed.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
